text: {"name":"lll_conn_state_alloc","confidence":"medium","docstring":"Selects and initializes one of two connection state slots, returning the selected slot index or 0xFF if the connection is inactive or both slots are occupied.","subsystem":"bt","var_renames":{"v7":"connection_table","v8":"connection_index","v9":"connection_entry","v10":"state_slot","v11":"connection_entry","v13":"selected_state","v14":"state_slot","v15":"connection_base","v17":"selected_state"},"struct_hints":[{"offset":112,"meaning":"Connection state gate; allocation proceeds only when this byte equals 1."},{"offset":16,"meaning":"Slot 0 occupied flag; set when slot 0 is selected."},{"offset":64,"meaning":"Slot 1 occupied flag; prevents allocation when already set."},{"offset":121,"meaning":"Byte counter incremented on each successful allocation."},{"offset":122,"meaning":"Byte counter incremented on successful allocation only when a2 is nonzero."},{"offset":19,"meaning":"Selected-slot configuration byte copied from a4."},{"offset":20,"meaning":"Second selected-slot configuration byte copied from a4."},{"offset":24,"meaning":"Selected-slot 32-bit field copied from a6."},{"offset":28,"meaning":"Selected-slot 32-bit field copied from a5."},{"offset":32,"meaning":"Selected-slot flag set to whether a2 is zero."},{"offset":33,"meaning":"Selected-slot byte copied from a3."},{"offset":36,"meaning":"Selected-slot 32-bit field copied from a7."},{"offset":40,"meaning":"Selected-slot 32-bit divisor or reload value derived from a5 when nonzero."}]}
